what_changed.alistar_r: src/calculator/champions/alistar.py's R (Unbreakable Will) leaves the absence pin and joins the slot map as a zero-damage self_state_events packet of kind=damage_modifier (Briar-E / Sivir-E seam), multiplier 1 - reduction%/100 over the ranked Damage Reduction row, active for the description's timing.active_duration window, declared physical+magic only (true damage is explicitly excluded by the cached ability note).
what_changed.fold_layer_dup_fix: participant_timeline._support_effect_templates named every self-state packet's published event id out of the champion module's own authored spelling (e.g. 'self_state:R:0:0'), with no owner prefix when the module supplied one. Two actors holding the same self-state mechanic on one roster panel — reachable for the first time by this slice, because R is the first Alistar mechanic to author self_state_events, and cassiopeia_5champ holds Alistar as both ally and enemy support — therefore authored the identical id twice, which precision.SumPlan refuses at construction (DuplicateSumMember). The new _owned_state_event_id helper prefixes every self-state id with its caster's participant id unless the id already names that participant, fixing the collision. This also renames every OTHER champion's already-authored self-state ids (Briar E, Sivir E) from their bare champion-local spelling to an owner-prefixed one (tests/test_briar_e.py's 'self_state:E:0:0' -> 'enemy:Briar:self_state:E:0:0'); no committed baseline captures event_id text, so this rename moves no golden or coupled_golden leaf and is visible only in the two test files that pin it directly.

qualifying_population.rule: R's self_state_events packet reduces incoming physical/magic damage on whichever actor casts it, only inside the roster-coupled walk (participant_timeline / cross-participant producers). The isolated single-target 'fights/<idx>:<name>' totals in golden_coupled_exact.json run the standalone pair path, which the coupled self_state seam never touches, so no fights/* key is eligible. A combat/* key is eligible only if it is (a) an Alistar entry's own 'incoming' total (directly re-priced by the multiplier, net of any true-damage component the multiplier excludes), (b) another entry's 'outgoing' total whose cross-target sum includes an Alistar target on the opposing side, or (c) an Alistar entry's own 'outgoing'/another Alistar entry's total where the roster's shared timeline reprices packet counts for every actor sharing the window once one actor's incoming damage changes (the same walk-order knock-on the wave2-statbuff and self-shield-carrier receipts describe for other roster slices). No 'main/incoming' key is eligible: nothing in this slice changes what main takes.

qualifying_population.level_and_rank: all three scenarios run Alistar at level 13 (scripts/bench_coupled_optimizer.py CASSIOPEIA_SCENARIO / FIVE_CHAMPION_SCENARIO / SYNDRA_MANDATE_SCENARIO), the same rank-2 bracket the pair-golden recapture pins at level 11 — 65% reduction, multiplier 0.35, 7s window. cassiopeia_3champ's enemy-Alistar incoming move (509.7 -> 178.4) is exactly old * 0.35, confirming rank 2 and no true-damage component in that build. cassiopeia_5champ's ally-Alistar incoming move (1290.1 -> 475.8) is NOT exactly old * 0.35 (would be 451.5): the enemy roster there adds Vayne, whose Silver Bolts true-damage passive is excluded from the modifier by design, so a fraction of Alistar's incoming survives the reduction — the module's declared damage_classes = {PHYSICAL, MAGIC} working as sourced.
